changes.change: Add to `constraints:` block a new key: `no_self_abort: true` with one-line note 'If invoked, complete the assigned flow end-to-end. Only exits are: (i) silent-intraday gate (Step 1 explicit), (ii) caught exception → FAILED telemetry. Self-refusal with English prose ("I cannot complete here") is forbidden — the agent IS running in chef.md context whenever invoked.'

Insert after the existing 'Intraday gate' block in Step 1 a new explicit gate-fired contract: `**Gate-fired contract:** When ≥1 cluster qualifies (or DISH_TYPE is morning/eod/evening), Steps 2-8 are MANDATORY. The agent MUST proceed. Self-refusal (e.g. "I cannot complete the full end-to-end execution here") is a flow violation — fail the cycle via FAILED telemetry instead.` Also tighten the 'try block begins here' callout to add: `Self-abort without an exception is a PO-defined violation; emit FAILED with reason="self-abort-no-exception" and EXIT non-zero.`
